negative_reviews.author: Taher Hamza
negative_reviews.text: The food was worse than average! We ordered different noodles and they all were so plain, no flavour and just didn’t taste nice. It was like noodles were added that were boiled. There was no synchrony in the dish. The drinks were bad. Only nice thing was sushi and that was only average too with a high price tag. Would definitely not recommend then place.
